name: haunted-station-floor-schematic
title: AWS Builder Loft, level 2: schematic floor plan
notice: SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE. Redrawn from a hand sketch made on site; zones are coarse, not rooms. Only the entrance on the building's SW side is verified from public sources. Not an architectural drawing, not for navigation.
source: Jarda's hand-drawn plan (Figma, on site, 2026-10-28): https://www.figma.com/design/hoMyQYoQfNspdNGmuqeijJ (page 1, 771 x 628 units, rescaled to 100 wide). Six site photos were used to name the zones.

space.orientation: plan-up is about NE, plan-right SE, plan-down SW (the courtyard side), plan-left NW (the Market Street side). Inferred: the entrance on the SW face is verified, and the windows left of the entrance look onto a street. The tower is a square rotated about 45 degrees, so this plan is a rotated view, not north up.

fields.position: verified = public source | sketched = taken from the hand-drawn plan or photos | assumed = a guess
fields.existence: verified | invented: whether the sector exists at all (scenarios/research/venue.md)

zones.label: Entrance
zones.basis: Courtyard Entrance on the building's SW side with stairs up (AICamp 2025 page, AWS startups page; may be dated). Drawn as the bottom-middle block labelled 'entrance' in Jarda's hand-drawn plan (Figma, on site, 2026-10-28) (node 1:30).
spots: the ID check at the security desk

zones.label: Registration
zones.basis: The plan draws two blocks labelled 'loby' (nodes 1:31, 1:33) either side of the entrance. The west one is taken as registration: the security guard's desk sits on the left inside the glass doors in photo 2, on the side with windows onto a street.

zones.label: Lounge
zones.basis: The east 'loby' block (node 1:33). Taken as the lounge: white and pink seating on the right inside the doors in photo 2, and the curved LED world-map wall in photo 3.

zones.label: Catering and coffee bar
zones.basis: The 'eating area' (nodes 1:26 and 1:37) in Jarda's hand-drawn plan (Figma, on site, 2026-10-28). Photos 4 and 5 show the catering counter, drinks fridge and blue-carpet tables.

zones.label: Main stage
zones.basis: The plan has no separate hall: the 'coding zone' (nodes 1:16, 1:35) is one big room. Photo 1 shows ceiling projectors and a podium in it, so the stage is taken as the north end of that room. Its exact place is a guess.

zones.label: Hack floor west
zones.basis: West half of the 'coding zone'. The east/west split is invented (venue.md); the room itself is drawn.

zones.label: Hack floor east
zones.basis: East half of the 'coding zone', including its south-east corner block (node 1:35). Photo 1 shows windows along this side.

zones.label: Network closet
zones.basis: Invented (venue.md). Put at the north end of the toilet block, off the hall, as a guess.

areas.label: Hall
areas.basis: The L-shaped 'Hall' (node 1:4) plus the stub 'hall' (node 1:15) in Jarda's hand-drawn plan (Figma, on site, 2026-10-28): it runs along the top, then down between the toilets and the coding zone to the entrance. The signage in photo 6 (partly legible) lists Restrooms, Reception, AWS Event Space, AWS User Group Commons, AWS Community Builder Base and a hack stage. The scenario's 'stage corridor' is taken to be this hall.

areas.label: Toilets
areas.basis: 'toilets' (node 1:21) in Jarda's hand-drawn plan (Figma, on site, 2026-10-28). The network closet is carved out of its north end.

features.label: Courtyard Entrance stairs
features.basis: West end of the building's SW side, next to the Chipotle and the fountain (AICamp 2025; OSM steps w941650785). Nightfall calls it the SW stairwell, landing 2. Where along the entrance block they land is a guess.

features.label: Street doors
features.basis: Glass doors at the foot of the stairs (photo 2 is taken from them), folded into the entrance block. Nightfall steps 19 and 22 hold the line here.

features.label: Security desk
features.basis: A guard sits at a desk on the left inside the glass doors (photo 2). Photo ID is checked first, then badges are issued at the Loft's registration desk (AWS Builder Loft page).

features.label: Registration desk
features.basis: Registration desk exists (AWS Builder Loft page); position assumed.

features.label: Lobby elevators
features.basis: Lobby elevators are named on the AWS startups event page. venue.md files 'the elevator' under the entrance sector. Position assumed.

features.label: Hall double doors
features.basis: Double doors with a signage panel behind them (photo 6) between the entrance and the hall. Assumed to be at this end of the hall.

features.label: Rear stage door (R2)
features.basis: Nightfall steps 20 and 21 name a rear door R2 next to the SW stairwell. Put on the stage room's west wall, opening onto the top hall.

features.label: Door to the coding zone
features.basis: The hall runs alongside the coding zone (the plan's 'hall separating toilets and the coding zone'). A door is assumed halfway down.

features.label: Stage
features.basis: Podium and projection screen exist (AWS renderings, photo 1). Place assumed.

features.label: Lounge side door
features.basis: Nightfall step 12: the lounge side door opens to hack floor west. In the plan the west half of the coding zone is directly north of the lounge.

features.label: Lounge main door
features.basis: Nightfall step 9 hangs a garlic braid on the lounge's main door frame. Placed on the wall shared with the entrance block.

features.label: Staff-only kitchen door
features.basis: Nightfall step 14: a staff-only kitchen door behind the catering counter. Placed on the wall shared with the top hall.

features.label: Freight lift
features.basis: Nightfall step 2: crates arrive by freight lift to the 2nd floor. Placed at the west end of the top hall.

features.label: Windows (street side)
features.basis: Tall windows on the left of the entrance hall looking onto a street with trees and an old building (photos 2, 3 and 4). Sunset side in the Nightfall scenario.

features.label: Windows (coding zone)
features.basis: Tall windows along the right wall of the coding zone, AWS logo on a pillar (photo 1).
